name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's motorsport journey began not on the track, but in the paddock. He started as a mechanic's assistant, lugging tires and cleaning parts, quickly learning the intricate dance of logistics that keeps a racing team running. His sharp eye for detail and relentless organizational skills soon saw him promoted, first to parts manager, then to assistant logistics coordinator. His decade of experience has instilled in him a deep understanding of the importance of precision timing and resource management in the high-pressure world of racing.

At Hot Racing Team, Jean-Pierre is known for his no-nonsense approach. He demands the best from his team and holds them accountable for every detail. Some find him abrasive, but everyone respects his unwavering commitment to ensuring everything is in its place, on time, every time. He believes that a smooth-running logistics operation is the unsung hero of any successful racing team. His experience makes him an invaluable asset, capable of anticipating potential problems and finding creative solutions before they impact the team's performance. His defining characteristic is his relentless pursuit of efficiency, ensuring that no resource is wasted and every opportunity is maximized.

physical.description: Jean-Pierre is of average height with a wiry build, suggesting a life spent in constant motion.

quirks: Insists on using a physical planner, even though the team uses digital calendars.
Always carries a multi-tool on his belt.
Has a specific brand of French coffee he must drink every morning.
